title: Elux Firerose 5000 Lemon Lime 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Lemon Lime from the Elux Firerose 5000 collection is a vibrant and refreshing flavour that perfectly encapsulates the essence of citrus. The sharpness of lemon provides a zesty and invigorating start, delivering a burst of freshness that awakens the senses. This is beautifully complemented by the sweet tanginess of lime, adding depth and a slightly sweeter edge to the flavour profile. This harmonious blend of lemon and lime creates a refreshing and moreish citrus vaping experience, ideal for those who appreciate the crisp and bright flavours of sunny citrus fruits. The tartness of the lemon is balanced by the sweetness of the lime, resulting in a well-rounded and satisfying vape that's both uplifting and enjoyable. With a 50VG/50PG blend, Berry Bang ensures a perfectly balanced vape that’s ideal for those who enjoy both intense flavour and satisfying yet discreet cloud production. The Nicotine Salt formulation provides a silky smoothness of the vape and is suitable for use in any MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping device. Discover the delicious world of Elux Firerose 5000 Nic Salt e-liquids. This captivating range is inspired by some of Elux’s most popular disposable vape flavours, offering the same intensity of flavour but with the versatility and convenience that comes from 10ml bottles for use with a wide variety of vape devices. Experience all dozen delicious Elux Firerose flavours available at Vapestore.
